reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Two-by-two nominal ATP/filament-length experiment with fluorescence step-finding; no measured chemistry or energy.

checks.reason: No explicit proposal to consult/check prior primary Methods or a validated protocol for detailed pre-execution conditions and transfer. Recording unknown settings and developing an assay locally do not satisfy this distinct requirement.

No prospective specific shaft-attachment/multi-motor validation or matched marker-free catalytic-activity control establishes that load changes preserve the enzyme/reporter coupling. Static and ATP-free controls address drift but do not replace these controls.
Core F1 construct, shaft-specific attachment and enzyme integrity are left as assumptions rather than resolved through an identity/activity/attachment feasibility plan.

The core immobilization/shaft attachment, solution chemistry (including nucleotide/free-magnesium conditions), recording settings and load manipulation lack an executable quantitative workflow or a concrete calibration-to-setting procedure. Lists of parameters to select later are insufficient.
Angular/temporal/chemical calibration tasks are named but no quantitative event-recovery/false-call or signal acceptance-to-action criterion, or concrete derivation of such tolerance, is specified.

Correct independent-preparation/chamber/molecule hierarchy is present, but the sample-size pilot does not specify a quantitative precision/power target linked to meaningful effect and between-preparation variance.
The analysis explicitly applies step-finding to unblinded traces, contradicting its earlier blinded-analysis promise; no locked-before-decoding procedure resolves this.
Requiring three turns before bleaching favors faster/longer-lived motors and no original denominator or inactive/irregular outcome retention is provided.
Primary estimands and hierarchical/held-out comparisons are present, but exact model assumptions/diagnostics and multiplicity control for the several primary load/coupling/event tests are incomplete.

checks.quote: linear regression on rotation rate versus ATP concentration
checks.reason: A generic linear regression spanning low and saturating ATP cannot identify specific kinetic constants of a saturable turnover relation. No regime restriction or kinetic model establishes the claimed rates.

ATP/load/acquisition optimization is not bounded by an explicit ladder or objective range-derivation/search-stop rule before the lock. A promise to select a spanning range from pilots is not a fully specified exploration policy.
Pilot separation and troubleshooting are described, but technical changes do not explicitly trigger a revised freeze and fresh independent confirmatory data under a defined change-control policy.

checks.quote: is a tightly coupled, discrete stepper motor
checks.reason: Detected staircase traces with ATP-sensitive waits do not demonstrate tight turnover coupling, nor prove all previous continuity was a load artifact. Erratic traces are also assigned to marker noise without discriminating genuine molecular heterogeneity.

No synthetic continuous-versus-step recovery, independent extraction, orthogonal turnover or physical reference confirmation is specified; one detector and the same fluorescence cannot independently validate inferred steps.
No full raw movie/trajectory/calibration manifest with unit identifiers, analysis versions/settings and all excluded/failed records is specified.

A relevant step-versus-continuous/load question, alternative predictions and proposed-versus-observed distinction are supplied. Specific causal/measurement defects are charged under controls and P09/P13 rather than duplicated.
